$description:
Selection contract — shared value tokens for bistate/selection controls
(Switch now; Checkbox + Radio next). The "on" fill is the brand primary, so a
checked control follows the brand axis AND each theme's primary for free.

The axis-dependent hooks (--a63-selection-accent / -track-off / -border /
-focus-ring, which reference mode/theme/brand semantics) are resolved at the
recipe USE-SITE via `var(--a63-selection-X, <live semantic>)` — declaring them
at :root would freeze their var()s to the root's mode/theme (the
resolve-at-declaration trap, learned on Input). So only the axis-independent
defaults live here: the knob colour and the switch geometry driver.

$root.$description: The knob — always white (an iOS switch thumb is white in light AND dark).

fg.$description: Ink on the white knob — fixed dark, never mode text (which washes out in dark).

size.$description: Drives the switch track geometry; iOS enlarges it in environment.css.
